event_detail: Drawer below the counter at the left corner: at 14.4 s the gripper is just below the black drawer handle (seen at the top of the wrist view). It then drifts down and along the cabinet face (16.0-19.2 s) without hooking or pulling the handle, and the drawer stays closed.
evidence: The shoulder views show the arm in nearly the same pose at the left end of the drawer in all 4 frames, with the drawer front flush and its handle in the same place. The wrist view changes from the handle plus floor (14.4 s) to just the cabinet panel and floor (16.0-19.2 s), with the open fingers empty. No drawer interior and no straw are visible. The robot may still be adjusting its approach, so confidence is moderate.
